Remark
[Derrick--Pohozaev identity] ↗ thm:derrick-pohozaev-nonexistence 1. ch9:9.4.2-rem-1\group Nonexistence

The Derrick–Pohozaev identity is \[ \frac{n-2}{2}\int _U|Du|^2\, dx +\frac12\int _{\partial U}|Du|^2(\nu \cdot x)\, dS =\frac{n}{p+1}\int _U|u|^{p+1}\, dx. \tag {18} \]
